items.title: Nogic – VS Code extension that visualizes your codebase as a graph
items.raw_excerpt: I built Nogic, a VSCode extension currently, because AI tools make code grow faster than developers can build a mental model by jumping between files. Exploring structure visually has been helping me onboard to unfamiliar codebases faster. It’s early and rough, but usable. Would love feedback on whether this is useful and what relationships are most valuable to visualize.

title_i18n.en: Nogic – VS Code extension that visualizes your codebase as a graph
title_i18n.zh: Nogic – 一款将代码库可视化为图形的VS Code扩展。
title_i18n.es: Nogic – Extensión de VS Code que visualiza tu base de código como un grafo.

excerpt_i18n.en: I built Nogic, a VSCode extension currently, because AI tools make code grow faster than developers can build a mental model by jumping between files. Exploring structure visually has been helping me onboard to unfamiliar codebases faster. It’s early and rough, but usable. Would love feedback on whether this is useful and what relationships are most valuable to visualize.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我开发了Nogic，目前是一款VSCode扩展，因为AI工具使代码增长速度超过了开发者通过文件跳转建立心智模型的能力。通过可视化探索代码结构，帮助我更快熟悉陌生项目。
excerpt_i18n.es: Creé Nogic, una extensión de VSCode actualmente, porque las herramientas de IA hacen que el código crezca más rápido de lo que los desarrolladores pueden construir un modelo mental saltando entre archivos. Explorar la estructura visualmente me ha estado ayudando a integrarme en código desconocido.
